audit_items.proof_trace: Both ADL entry points (`liquidate_adl_borrow` L224, `liquidate_adl_deposit` L273) call `pre_liquidation_check` with `whitelist_admin::adl()` = 3 (bit index 3), distinct from `whitelist_admin::liquidation()` = 2 (bit index 2). `ensure_has_permission` checks `(stored_permission & (1u32 << 3)) != 0`; a cap with only liquidation bit set (value 4) yields `4 & 8 = 0`, causing the assertion to fire and rejecting the caller. The separation is enforced atomically at every ADL entry point.
